title: Dara
description: Dara — a lightweight, atmospheric shader pack for Iris: soft shadows, warm torchlight, animated water with highlights, and cinematic color grading — with no FPS hit.
body:
# 🌅 Dara Shaders

**Dara** is a lightweight, atmospheric shader pack for Iris, built for players who want
a beautiful look without sacrificing performance. No heavy ray tracing or expensive
passes — just a carefully balanced mix of light, color, and atmosphere.

## ✨ Features

- 🔆 **Soft directional lighting** — terrain and entities react in real time to the
  position of the sun and moon
- 🌗 **Soft shadows (shadow map)** — objects cast shadows with light PCF smoothing,
  no harsh pixelated edges
- 🔥 **Dynamic light blending** — warm orange torchlight contrasts with cool blue
  skylight, blended based on each block's light level
- 🌊 **Living water** — animated surface waves combined with sun-glint highlights
- 🌌 **Gradient sky** — a smooth transition from zenith to horizon, with a glowing
  sun and moon
- 💫 **Bloom & color grading** — soft glow on bright areas, boosted saturation,
  cinematic tone mapping, and a subtle vignette
- ⚡ **Performance-friendly** — no unnecessary passes or expensive effects, runs
  smoothly even on weaker hardware

## 📋 Requirements

- [Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) (Fabric/Quilt) **or** OptiFine
- Minecraft: Java Edition

## 🔧 Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader and the Iris mod (or OptiFine)
2. Download `Dara.zip` from the Files section above
3. Place the archive — without extracting it — into `.minecraft/shaderpacks/`
4. In-game: go to **Video Settings → Shaders → Dara**

## 🎨 Design philosophy

Dara aims for a warm, cinematic feel rather than photorealism. Sunsets glow,
torchlight feels cozy against a cool night sky, and water catches the light
without slowing your game down. It's meant to make vanilla worlds feel a
little more alive — without turning your PC into a space heater.

## 🛠️ Planned improvements

- [ ] Higher-quality shadow filtering (PCSS)
- [ ] Volumetric light shafts
- [ ] Water reflections
- [ ] In-shader configurable options menu
